summary.en: How to start: an ink block where one or two commands type out after a prompt with a block cursor, an optional note, then numbered steps under 4 px rules; the cursor blinks on every beat while the page holds and the music rests.
summary.zh: 怎么开始：一块墨色区里，一两条命令跟在提示符后打出来，带块状光标；可选一行注释，然后是 4 px 细线下的编号步骤；停留时光标每拍闪一下，音乐在这里休息。

fits: The rest before the closing claim: install command and first steps of a developer tool.
notFor: Products without a command line; more than two commands; commands longer than 36 characters.

intent.en: A pause that is also a call to act: real commands typing out in a quiet bar tell a developer exactly how to begin.
intent.zh: 一段既是停顿也是行动召唤的休息：安静的小节里真实命令逐字打出，告诉开发者从哪开始。

content.en: Title, panel label, 1–2 commands (code, ≤ 36 chars), an optional note, 2–4 steps of a command (≤ 16) and a note (≤ 24).
content.zh: 标题、面板标签、1–2 条命令（代码，≤ 36 字符）、可选注释、2–4 步“命令（≤ 16 字符）+ 说明（≤ 9 字）”。

fits.zh: 结尾主张之前的休息：开发者工具的安装命令和头几步。

notFor.zh: 没有命令行的产品；超过两条命令；超过 36 字符的命令。

pairs.note: its command block carries into the tagline's bar (block-carry)

en: Commands are code and stay Latin in Chinese films; translate only the notes.
zh: 命令是代码，中文片里也保持拉丁字符；只翻译说明。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
